name: OpenAgent-X
tagline: Open, model-agnostic AI Operating System for verifiable agentic work
principle: One interface. Any model. Many specialist agents. Unified memory. Secure tools. Verifiable execution.

layers.name: Experience
layers.responsibilities: Web app, desktop shell, CLI, API, voice, notifications, admin screens

layers.name: Identity & Policy
layers.responsibilities: Users, roles, project membership, approvals, secret references, permission decisions

layers.name: Orchestration Control Plane
layers.responsibilities: Task intake, planning, decomposition, dispatch, budgets, retries, deadlines, approvals, state transitions, recovery
layers.interfaces: Durable workflow API, event store, agent contracts

layers.name: Intelligence
layers.responsibilities: Model registry, provider gateway, capability checks, routing, context assembly, evaluation, verification

layers.name: Agent Workforce
layers.responsibilities: Research, coding, data, math/science, browser, writing, memory, QA agents

layers.name: Tools & Execution
layers.responsibilities: Browser, terminal, code runner, file/document tools, APIs, external runtimes, sandbox lifecycle
layers.interfaces: MCP, HTTP APIs, container/VM runner APIs

layers.name: Data & Compute
layers.responsibilities: Relational records, vector retrieval, object artifacts, caches, observability, local/cloud inference
layers.interfaces: PostgreSQL/pgvector, object store, Redis, telemetry, model endpoints

task_states.meaning: Request accepted and assigned a task ID
Plan and subtasks validated; budgets and permissions estimated
Human approval captured and bound to a specific plan/action hash
One or more activities are executing
Evidence, artifacts, tests and policy compliance are checked
An approval, missing input or user decision is required
Cannot proceed due to permission, dependency, environment or policy
A retry, replan or workspace restore is being performed
Task exhausted recovery policy or violated a hard constraint
User or policy stopped the task

permission_tiers.name: Reversible local
permission_tiers.examples: Draft, copy file, edit sandbox content

permission_tiers.name: Sandboxed execution
permission_tiers.examples: Run tests, approved installs, isolated browser
permission_tiers.control: Container/VM boundary, quotas, egress policy, secret scoping

permission_tiers.name: External side effect
permission_tiers.examples: Send, publish, create PR, update external DB
permission_tiers.control: Human approval of exact action/destination/payload; idempotency

permission_tiers.name: Privileged
permission_tiers.examples: Production deploy, destructive admin, financial ops
permission_tiers.control: Disabled unless enabled; re-auth, high-assurance approval

agent_roles.responsibilities: Own task graph and workflow; not a free-form worker
agent_roles.verification: Plan schema, policy checks, state invariants

agent_roles.responsibilities: Find, inspect, compare and synthesize sources
Modify repository and run scoped checks
agent_roles.verification: Diff review, tests, static checks, dependency review

agent_roles.responsibilities: Profile data, build analysis pipeline, generate artifacts
Formalize problems, derive and test technical claims

agent_roles.verification: Action preconditions, screenshots, final state confirmation

agent_roles.responsibilities: Turn verified inputs into structured documents
agent_roles.verification: Consistency with evidence, format and completeness checks

agent_roles.responsibilities: Extract candidate project facts and decisions
agent_roles.verification: Provenance, confidence, scope, user correction path

agent_roles.responsibilities: Independently test outputs against acceptance criteria
agent_roles.verification: Must not merely echo the producing agent; separate evidence

routing_profiles.emphasis: Low latency and cost; strict output validation

routing_profiles.use: Everyday planning, summarization, routine agent work
Complex planning, mathematical reasoning, multi-step diagnosis
routing_profiles.emphasis: Measured task quality, long context, tool control

routing_profiles.use: Code understanding, patch generation, test repair
routing_profiles.emphasis: Repository-level task success, coding tool support
Local endpoint, privacy boundary, feasible capability

api_surface.purpose: Read task state, plan summary, progress
Internal tool-gateway endpoint (not for untrusted clients)

references.name: OpenAgent
references.use_as: Provider coverage, RAG ingestion, tool patterns, MCP management, workflow builder, analytics
references.do_not: Copy its full agent loop / provider registry / workflow engine as a second control plane

references.name: MIRA
references.use_as: Memory patterns, wiki, briefings, skills, policy ideas (pattern-level only)
references.do_not: Adopt Rust gateway or memory/agent architecture as core dependency; no code reuse without legal review

references.name: OpenHands
references.use_as: Primary coding runtime adapter via Software Agent SDK / Agent Server
references.do_not: Treat product as one repo with one responsibility

references.name: Agent Zero
references.use_as: Workspace isolation, profiles, plugin/skill patterns, snapshots; optional runtime adapter
references.do_not: Let it become a peer master orchestrator with independent permissions/memory

references.name: Interpreter Workstation
references.use_as: Computer-facing workspace, host/browser bridge separation, read-only publishing
references.do_not: Adopt host computer access as default
